title: Listening Drill — Path signage trial
description: Project planning dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Path signage trial
sections.transcript:
COORDINATOR: Thanks for joining this planning meeting about temporary signs. The progress report is due on Wednesday. We need to agree what can be ready before then.

MEMBER: I'll start by checking the route survey. That should tell us whether the previous team has already solved part of the problem.

COORDINATOR: Good. For the trial we will use the yellow sign. Send your results to Alice first, not to the whole group. I don't want unconfirmed figures copied into the report.

MEMBER: Understood. We should also remember that some readers will approach from behind. I'll make a note of that in the schedule.
